timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹279.81 Cr (+51.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹4.5 Cr.
Board of Directors recommended final dividend of ₹1.40 per equity share (70% of face value) for FY2026, payable within 30 days of AGM approval.
Hind Rectifiers approved a ₹100 Cr preferential issue of equity shares to Tata Mutual Fund at ₹920.50 per share.
Hind Rectifiers reported FY26 standalone revenue of ₹949.2 Cr, up 44.8% YoY, with net profit rising to ₹57.7 Cr.
FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹999.1 Cr (+52.5% YoY), EBITDA ₹84.1 Cr (+19.6%), PAT after minority interest ₹45.0 Cr (+21.3%); order book ₹845.5 Cr and board approved a 1:1 bonus issue.
Hirect Limited shared Q4 & FY2026 earnings conference call recording on May 18, 2026, via its website.
